source_segments.text: They realized that there was no support system in place for new and upcoming rock musicians and bands in India.
They only had college fests as platforms.
According to Sam, "The community was large and strong but very fragmented at the same time.
When we thought about this, we decided to come up with RSJ which would provide news about rock music anywhere in the country."
And thus "RSJ" was born to bring a sense of community among these struggling musicians, the first issue published from Allahabad in January 1993.
It was initially planned as subscription-only magazine.
